decisions.reason: The source modification changes the format and detail level of the result explanation, not the dashboard score, heading, prominence, or displayed result fields.
Presenting weaknesses as concise bullets does not change which customer-specific fields must remain editable.
The result-explanation refinement does not alter the footer's presentation or page coverage.
The front-page explanation format does not change the independently specified internal-page header.
The candidate's existing same-message modification already captures the global readability and refinement priorities; the bullet-format details belong specifically to the source Requirement.
The front-page explanation change does not alter the final-page confidentiality warning's presence, message, or visual treatment.
The explanation's bullet formatting and detail placement do not affect the RR-01 identifier requirement.
Changing front-page explanatory content presentation does not alter required source formats, report variants, editability, or PDF export support.
The source decision changes explanatory presentation only and does not modify score-to-variant, risk-band, or exposure-level mapping.
The result-explanation refinement does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their handoff purpose.
